verdict.rationale: Google Drive is a storage/service product, not an AI agent client role, but the story specifically asks about plugging MCP servers INTO Drive so it can use their tools — this is a client-role capability that applies to agents, not to a SaaS storage product consuming external tool servers. Evidence only shows Drive's own API/add-on ecosystem (e.g., building agents that use Drive via ADK/Vertex AI), not Drive itself acting as an MCP client consuming external MCP servers, so this axis is a category error for this product type.
